entries.title: Effective confinement of very small Margulis numbers
entries.scope: The precise Futer–Purcell–Schleimer theorem confines every orientable finite-volume hyperbolic three-manifold with μ(M)≤0.29 to a closed bounded-volume class with explicit positive systole bound. The report explains finiteness and the distinction between this effective exceptional class and the prompt's proposed Weeks minimizer. It does not certify the candidate value or uniqueness.

entries.title: Ordered bending measures determine a non-Fuchsian punctured-torus group
entries.scope: Part (b) is affirmative when S is a once-punctured torus, by Series's bending-measure uniqueness theorem for marked quasifuchsian groups with ordered ends. The report explains the fixed-pleating-locus monotonicity argument and separates actual measured data from projective supports. It does not settle part (a) or higher-complexity punctured surfaces.

entries.title: Polynomial certificates for sphere recognition: positive witnesses and conditional negative witnesses
entries.scope: Schleimer's NP theorem for triangulated S³ recognition is paired with Zentner's GRH-conditional finite-field certificate for non-sphericity of integer homology three-spheres. The input-encoding and verifier arguments are explicit. Neither deterministic polynomial time nor a general two-input homeomorphism bound is claimed.

entries.title: An explicit spherical Pachner bound, including the size of intermediate triangulations
entries.scope: For closed PL three-spheres in the standard face-pairing triangulation convention, Mijatović's explicit bound gives d_P(T1,T2)<F(t1)+F(t2), F(t)=6·10^6 t²2^(50000t²), with an explicit bound on intermediate tetrahedron counts. No universal three-manifold bound, polynomial bound, or lower bound is asserted.

entries.title: A terminating left-orderability decision for graph-manifold rational homology spheres
entries.scope: On the promised class of closed connected orientable irreducible graph-manifold rational homology spheres with nontrivial fundamental group, left-orderability is decidable by exact mod-two hat Heegaard Floer rank. The report specifies termination and finite trace certificates measured in their expanded size, without asserting a polynomial bound in triangulation size or a decision procedure for all three-manifolds.

entries.title: A terminating genus-two surface-isotopy algorithm, with the point at infinity retained
entries.scope: Baroni's oriented genus-two classification algorithm decides ambient isotopy for connected tame genus-two surfaces in R³ after orienting by the unbounded complementary side. The passage from S³ to R³ and compatible gluing requirement are explained. No arbitrary-genus or disconnected-input decision is claimed.

entries.title: Unordered Heegaard stabilization: explicit linear upper bounds and equal-genus lower families
entries.scope: For the prompt's surface-isotopy convention allowing side interchange, Johnson's theorems give a universal common-stabilization upper bound floor(7g/2−1) for g≥1, and for every k>1 equal genus g=2k pairs requiring at least k−1 stabilizations each. These do not settle the proposed 2g upper bound.

entries.title: The simple loop conjecture for Sol targets, with a direct torus-bundle compression argument
entries.scope: Zemke's published theorem proves the literal two-sided simple loop conjecture for closed Sol three-manifolds and its corollary for closed targets finitely covered by torus bundles. A self-contained orientable-domain torus-bundle argument is supplied; arbitrary three-manifold targets are not settled.

entries.title: Integral linearity for mixed three-manifold groups, including finite-extension faithfulness
entries.scope: Every compact connected oriented irreducible mixed three-manifold, with arbitrary possibly empty boundary, has fundamental group linear over Z by Przytycki–Wise. Given an index-m subgroup with a faithful d-dimensional integral representation, the report constructs a faithful md-dimensional representation of the full group. It gives no uniform or triangulation-effective bound on m or d and no claim for all closed graph-manifold groups.

entries.title: Realizing PD₃ groups with a normal infinite cyclic subgroup
entries.scope: Every finitely presented integral PD₃ group containing a normal Z is the fundamental group of a closed aspherical Seifert 3-manifold, including the source's nonorientable Seifert convention. No realization theorem without the normal-cyclic hypothesis is claimed.

entries.title: Negative surgery as a broad tight-contact existence class
entries.scope: Precisely attributed 2025 Li–Wan–Zhou preprint: every negative rational surgery on every S³ knot has a positive cooriented tight contact structure with nonzero Heegaard Floer contact invariant. This covers every such surgery manifold that is hyperbolic, without asserting that all oriented hyperbolic manifolds have that surgery description.

entries.title: Explicit high-surgery thresholds yielding Stein fillings
entries.scope: The high rational surgery assertion is proved by credited theorems for all closed 3-braid L-space knots, their connected sums, all torus knots and their connected sums, and specified pretzels. Explicit thresholds are supplied for two twisted-torus families. No theorem for every knot is claimed.

entries.title: Zero torsion under strong fillability and unbounded torsion across tight tori
entries.scope: Every strongly symplectically fillable contact 3-manifold has Giroux torsion zero. On the fixed manifold T³, tight structures realize arbitrarily large lower bounds on Giroux torsion. This separates pointwise finiteness from a false uniform bound; it does not establish finiteness for an arbitrary fixed tight structure.

entries.title: Finite multiplicity obstructions to fillability of a specified planar open book
entries.scope: For a fixed planar open book, Wendl's theorem converts strong/Stein fillability into positive allowable factorization of that same monodromy. The report proves an effective finite nonnegative-integer obstruction using annular and pairwise multiplicities, with an explicit infinite family ruled out. This is a one-sided obstruction, not a general tightness or fillability decider; weak fillability is not covered.

entries.title: Why connected sums of genus-one examples do not raise support genus
entries.scope: Precise report of Orbegozo Rodriguez–Stenhede arXiv:2607.19892v1: support genus of a contact connected sum is at most the maximum of the two support genera. This rules out one proposed construction of support genus >1, without constructing such a structure or claiming a lower bound for all supporting open books.

entries.title: Infinite Reeb-orbit multiplicity with torsion Chern class, including degenerate forms
entries.scope: For every closed connected non-lens 3-manifold, every contact form whose contact structure has torsion c₁ has infinitely many simple Reeb orbits, with no nondegeneracy assumption. In particular this covers all non-lens rational homology spheres. Forms with non-torsion c₁ are not included.

entries.scope: Ferrari–Kolpakov–Reid's published infinite families geometrically bound compact hyperbolic four-manifolds, but those constructions have nonorientable fillings. The orientation double cover supplies two boundary copies, not the single boundary demanded in the prompt.

entries.title: Quantum queries do not enlarge PP: an explicit signed-count simulation
entries.scope: The established Fortnow–Rogers lowness theorem PP^BQP=PP, explained through exact fixed-gate path counts, common denominators, adaptive oracle transcripts and exponential error control. This is a counting-class upper bound and decides neither NP subset BQP nor BQP subset NP.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Simon search: explicit quantum success and adaptive classical lower bounds
entries.scope: For uniformly randomly labeled Simon oracles on n-bit addresses, O(n+log(1/delta)) quantum queries recover the hidden XOR with failure<=delta, while classical randomized search needs Omega(2^(n/2)) queries for constant average success. Full finite-distribution and adaptive-transcript proofs are supplied; this is an oracle/promise result and does not separate ordinary BQP from BPP.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: A division-free logspace-uniform parallel algorithm for determinant
entries.scope: For matrices over F₂, reconstruct polynomial-size logspace-uniform Boolean circuits of depth O(log²n) for characteristic polynomial, determinant and adjugate; nonsingular systems can consequently be solved in the same depth. For binary integer matrices, explicitly charged arithmetic yields polynomial-size polylogarithmic-depth uniform Boolean circuits. This significant linear-algebra subclass does not establish NC=P.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Parity games as a total dual-certificate language with a quasipolynomial algorithm
entries.scope: The total explicitly encoded parity-game winner language is placed in NP∩coNP using checked positional-strategy certificates, and the credited Calude–Jain–Khoussainov–Li–Stephan quasipolynomial algorithm is specialized with binary priority and input-length accounting. This does not decide whether all NP∩coNP languages are in P.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Raz–Tal distributions: the missing quantitative bridge to PH oracle hardness
entries.scope: Carefully credited Raz–Tal2018 Theorems1.1–1.3 and Corollaries1.4–1.5, with a full explanation of distributional-to-promise conversion and fixed-level PH circuit unrolling. This gives established oracle hardness only, not the literal unrelativized BQP noncontainment in PH.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: A fully charged random-walk 3-SAT upper bound
entries.scope: A Schöning-style one-sided randomized3SAT algorithm with O((4/3)^n poly(|F|,n)) worst-case bit time and error below1/3, proved via an explicit6n-step change-of-measure calculation and bounded fair-bit sampling. This algorithmic upper bound is credited and does not refute the prompt's deterministic positive-rate ETH.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Exact witness optimization for Clifford verifiers with a conjunction output test
entries.scope: For an explicitly encoded unitary Clifford verifier with ancillas initialized to zero, arbitrary quantum witnesses and acceptance iff specified output qubits are all zero, the maximum witness acceptance is exactly zero or a computable power of1/2, found in polynomial bit time. Hence this QMA verifier subclass has a classical polynomial-time decision procedure; arbitrary verifier postprocessing/non-Clifford gates are excluded.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: A complete sparse determinant witness for every permanent size
entries.scope: Explicitly reconstructs the established Grenet upper bound dc(per_n)<=2^n-1 by a fully specified subset-graph matrix and exact cycle-cover/sign proof. Entries are0,1 and signed input variables; sparse and dense output costs are accounted for. This exact upper witness neither proves nor disproves superpolynomial determinantal complexity.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Planar graph canonization as a credited deterministic logarithmic-space subclass
entries.scope: Credit the Datta–Limaye–Nimbhorkar–Thierauf–Wagner planar canonization theorem and derive a deterministic O(log L)-space isomorphism comparison without storing either canonical string, for explicitly encoded finite simple planar graphs. The theorem addresses one substantial polynomial-time subclass and does not put all of P in L.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Beyond ACC: quasipolynomial lower bounds with bottom threshold gates
entries.scope: Williams arXiv1401.2444v1 Theorem1.3: NEXP has no nonuniform quasipolynomial-size ACC composed with a bottom layer of arbitrary threshold gates; the analogous ACC composed with symmetric gates is also stated. Exact counting-SAT/weak-AND-closure hypotheses are explained. This stronger restricted-class frontier is not NEXP outside unrestricted P/poly.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: SETH to logarithmic-dimensional orthogonal vectors, with every exponent paid
entries.scope: Full split-and-list reduction: a uniformly truly subquadratic deterministic bichromatic Boolean Orthogonal Vectors algorithm in every fixed logarithmic dimension would refute SETH. Includes the sparse-dimension conversion, list construction and quantified constant accounting. This is an established conditional fine-grained implication, not a proof of SETH or an unconditional OV lower bound.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Width-five permutation programs are an exact reformulation of the formula target
entries.scope: The classical nonuniform NC¹ = polynomial-length width-five permutation-program characterization is reconstructed, including both simulations. Therefore a uniformly P-computable family separates P from the prompt’s nonuniform formulas exactly when it requires superpolynomial length in this specific width-five model.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Exact clique counting through three compatible blocks
entries.scope: An explicit uniform exact k-clique counting algorithm reduces to one integer matrix multiplication on at most n^ceil(k/3) rows/columns. Strassen gives O(n^(log2(7)ceil(k/3))) integer arithmetic operations, plus compatibility construction, with polynomial-size integer operands and explicit bit/address accounting. This established XP algorithm is not FPT.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Bateman-Horn conjecture
entries.scope: Precisely reports Browning–Sofos–Teräväinen's May2026 coefficient-averaged finite-window Bateman–Horn theorem, including truncated constant, signed von Mangoldt convention, two varying coefficients and rangec<5/(31d). Proves an almost-sure sequence-of-polynomials consequence and why it does not imply any prescribed fixed-tuple asymptotic.

entries.title: Square-root-space time simulation: an exponential-time specialization with exact quantifiers
entries.scope: Williams’s 2025 multitape simulation TIME(t) ⊆ SPACE(√(t log t)) is credited, specialized to every fixed exponential bound, and used with the space hierarchy to derive the known fixed-exponent time lower bound for linear space. Neither the full-union PSPACE/EXPTIME equality nor separation is claimed.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Unbounded Ranks of Elliptic Curves over Q
entries.scope: Uses the checked Bhargava–Shankar 5-Selmer mean theorem to prove exponential upper-density bounds for every rational-rank tail and a bound for its contribution to average rank, including congruence families. Shows explicitly why these bounds neither prove nor refute unbounded ranks.
entries.author: /root/hundred_numbers

entries.title: Topological rigidity for virtually solvable fundamental groups, with an explicit nilmanifold family
entries.scope: Every homotopy equivalence between closed aspherical topological manifolds of dimension at least five with virtually solvable fundamental group is homotopic to a homeomorphism, by Wegner’s coefficient Farrell–Jones theorem and Bartels–Lück Proposition0.3; includes an explicit nonabelian nilmanifold family.
entries.author: /root/hundred_topology

entries.title: Serre's congruence subgroup conjecture
entries.scope: Credited Bass–Milnor–Serre theorem for SL_n, n>=3, and Sp_2m, m>=2, over all global fields and nonempty finite S containing archimedean places: kernel roots of unity for totally imaginary archimedean-only S, trivial otherwise. Prove the resulting finite-quotient factorization and local completion description for SL_n over number fields with a real place.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: The randomized partial-MCSP hardness theorem and its exact totalization gap
entries.scope: Hirahara’s 2022 Theorem 1.2 is reported with its explicit partial truth table, randomized one-query reduction, circuit-size gap and input-length normalization. Its implication for partial-MCSP approximation is derived, and a precise sufficient deterministic totalization condition is stated. No deterministic NP-hardness of ordinary total MCSP is claimed.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Cubic formula lower bounds and an exact fan-out/basis warning
entries.scope: Credits the Filmus–Meir–Tal2021 tilde-Omega(n^3) De Morgan formula lower bound for an explicit AC0 family, and proves the Khrapchenko edge bound with parity application L(parity)>=n^2 versus unrestricted B2 circuit size exactly n-1. These restricted-model results do not yield the literal omega(n) general-circuit lower bound.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Murre's Chow-Kunneth Conjectures
entries.scope: Prove A–D with the literal every-decomposition quantifier for every smooth projective complex toric variety, more generally every smooth projective X with cycle-class isomorphisms on X and X² and no odd cohomology. Construct dual-basis projectors; cohomological injectivity forces uniqueness and the complete trivial filtration.

entries.title: Carry-free cubing counts distinct-element 3SUM exactly
entries.scope: For distinct integers S⊆[−U,U], exact 3SUM decision and the number of unordered distinct zero-sum triples are computable deterministically in O((n+U+1) log²(n+U+2)) bit time using fast integer multiplication. This is subquadratic for U=O(n^(2−ε)), for fixed ε>0; it does not handle the prompt’s U=n³ worst case.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Simplicity of the Nontrivial Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
entries.scope: Checks the published unconditional Bui–Conrey–Young simple-critical-zero proportion and derives explicit lower counts in every sufficiently large multiplicative window(T,λT] for λ>1/0.4058, including λ=3. Preserves multiplicity/counting conventions and separates this theorem from RH-conditional and unaudited2026 claims.

entries.title: Uniform constant-depth completeness gives actual polynomial-time isomorphisms
entries.scope: Agrawal’s uniform constant-depth isomorphism theorem implies the Berman–Hartmanis conclusion for NP languages complete under DLOGTIME-uniform AC⁰ many-one reductions. Both the bijection and its inverse are polynomial-time computable. Completeness merely under arbitrary polynomial-time reductions is not covered.

entries.title: Voevodsky's Smash-Nilpotence Conjecture
entries.scope: Credited Sebastian numerical=smash for one-cycles on arbitrary products of curves and arbitrary abelian varieties over algebraically closed fields. Prove transfer along generically finite surjective morphisms from products of curves between smooth projective equal-dimensional varieties; no higher-codimension universal theorem or composition-nilpotence shortcut.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Kimura–O'Sullivan Finite-Dimensionality Conjecture
entries.scope: Over C, for every smooth projective surface S whose rational Chow motive is generated by curves—in particular, every abelian surface and every surface admitting a generically finite dominating morphism from a product of curves—all Hilbert schemes S^[n] and finite products thereof have Kimura finite-dimensional rational Chow motives. Credit curve/closure and deCataldo–Migliorini decomposition, prove summand transfer and quotient-averaging interpretation; no universal finite-dimensionality claim.

entries.title: Exact optimality in every dihedral Fourier-label block
entries.scope: For N≥1, t≥0 and fixed known Fourier labels k∈(Z/NZ)^t, the optimal uniform-prior success for distinguishing the hidden reflection from t phase-qubit states is (Σx√ηx)²/(N·2^t), where ηx counts subset sums. Every such measurement has success≤min(1,2^t/N). This is a finite-block state-discrimination theorem, not an efficient circuit or a lower bound for arbitrary oracle algorithms.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: An always-halting RL simulation below the three-halves logarithmic-space bound
entries.scope: For the prompt’s unbiased read-once, all-random-tapes-halting RL model, the credited Hoza 2021 theorem yields deterministic work space O((log(N+2))^{3/2}/√loglog(N+4)). A configuration-to-branching-program translation and exact one-sided acceptance threshold are supplied; L = RL is not concluded.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Coxeter-manifold Singer vanishing, explicit middle Betti numbers and higher-dimensional edge degrees
entries.scope: Reports Davis–Okun Singer vanishing for closed aspherical Davis manifolds from finite flag PL spheres in dimensions 3 and 4, computes the dimension-four middle L2-Betti number from the flag-sphere f-vector, and reports b1 and b(n−1) vanishing in the same Coxeter construction for every n≥3.
entries.author: /root/hundred_topology

entries.title: Majority lower bounds for every fixed power-of-two modulus
entries.scope: Majority is outside nonuniform polynomial-size constant-depth circuits with AND, OR, NOT and MOD_{2^a} gates for every fixed a≥1. A full reduction of MOD_{2^a} to polynomial-size AC⁰[2] is proved, and the parity-modulus lower bound follows from the credited Smolensky–Szegedy approximate-degree lemma plus an explicit probabilistic-polynomial construction. Moduli with distinct prime factors remain outside this result.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: A complete norm-graph proof of the sharp K3,3 extremal exponent
entries.scope: The literal total-vertex extremal function satisfies z_3(n)=Theta(n^(5/3)). A characteristic-two norm graph, a complete common-neighbor proof, bipartite doubling and padding give the lower bound for every n≥16; a triple-counting argument gives the matching upper bound. No assertion for all fixed t≥4 is made.
entries.author: /root/hundred_graphs

entries.title: Grigorchuk Gap Conjecture
entries.scope: Precisely scoped Eberhard–Maini arXiv2511.07018v1 Theorems1.1/2.6: sub-quarter logarithmic growth forces virtual nilpotence for finitely generated residually soluble groups; full square-root gap for residually finite soluble groups of uniformly bounded self-centralizing chief rank. Derive scale-invariant consequences and explain unsolved endpoint/general gap.

entries.title: Montgomery's Large Value Conjecture for Dirichlet Polynomials
entries.scope: Precisely normalized Guth–Maynard large-value theorem and classical comparison, with proved exponent-region consequences, a conjectured-order high-amplitude regime and an exact critical σ=3/4 phase calculation showing the remaining polynomial gap.

entries.title: A moving-weight proof of the splay working-set theorem
entries.scope: For n≥1 fixed keys and m accesses, let tᵢ be the accessed key’s move-to-front recency rank before access i, starting from any fixed ordering. In the one-plus-rotations convention, total splay cost≤Σᵢ(6log₂tᵢ+5)+2nlog₂n+n. This credited classical temporal-locality theorem has explicit initialization and is not dynamic optimality.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Original Dubrovin conjecture for Fano manifolds
entries.scope: All complex Grassmannians Gr(r,N), 1≤r<N, satisfy the original Section4.6 Dubrovin package with its analytic and admissible-phase conventions. Credit Galkin–Golyshev–Iritani; identify the original commuting central factor explicitly and retain mutations/coalescence qualifications. No assertion for arbitrary Fano manifolds.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Dense high-girth components with an all-orders padding argument
entries.scope: For each fixed k≥4 and every sufficiently large n, a simple n-vertex graph of girth>2k has Ω_k(n^(1+1/d_k)) edges, where d_k=ceil(3(k−1)/2). Uses the credited Lazebnik–Ustimenko–Woldar construction and proves the passage from unknown component orders to every large n. This is a versioned classical lower bound, not a claim of the current best bound or the conjectured exponent1+1/k.
entries.author: /root/hundred_graphs

entries.title: Log-Brunn-Minkowski Inequality for Symmetric Convex Bodies
entries.scope: Böröczky–Lutwak–Yang–Zhang’s complete planar origin-symmetric log-Brunn–Minkowski theorem and equality classification, plus a direct proof that the planar cone-volume entropy inequality implies the literal Wulff-volume inequality; no all-dimensional claim is adopted.
entries.author: /root/hundred_geometry

entries.title: Brauer's k(B) Conjecture
entries.scope: Credited Brauer bound for every block with odd-prime metacyclic defect. For nonabelian split metacyclic defect derive k(B)<=|D|/p^2+(1-1/p^2)|D:Dprime|<|D| from the published height-weighted bound; show sharp ratio(p^2+p-1)/p^3 on orderp^3 modular groups. No general block conclusion.

entries.title: A p-optimal tautology system would yield a complete disjoint NP pair
entries.scope: A complete self-contained proof shows that existence of a p-optimal Cook–Reckhow tautology system implies existence of a polynomial-many-one complete disjoint NP pair. The same implication already follows from proof-length optimality. This necessary consequence does not prove that such a system or pair exists.

entries.title: Strong Hyperplane Conjecture for Isotropic Constants
entries.scope: Kipp’s2025 Proposition6.1 proves the sharp cube bound L_Z<=1/sqrt12 for every full-dimensional n-zonotope with at most n+1 generators, with equality precisely for parallelepipeds; its fixed-class deformation proof is separated from hypothetical local-maximizer theorems and the full simplex conjecture.
entries.author: /root/hundred_geometry

entries.title: Fujita Freeness Conjecture
entries.scope: For every positive-dimensional complex abelian variety A and every ample line bundle L, prove L^m globally generated for every m>=2, hence K_A+(n+1)L generated in all dimensions, with no product-polarization or globally-generated-L hypothesis. Translate divisors with zero-sum parameters using theorem of square.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Kobayashi Conjecture: Hyperbolic Compact Kähler Manifolds Have Ample Canonical Bundle
entries.scope: Every smooth connected complex projective Kobayashi-hyperbolic surface has ample canonical bundle. Supply the missing bigness step from Enriques classification and Bogomolov–Mumford’s rational-curve theorem for projective K3s, then the Hodge-index/adjunction argument. No general nonprojective Kahler or higher-dimensional assertion.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Lück's Determinant Conjecture for Discrete Groups
entries.scope: For every sofic group and every square integral group-ring matrix, prove the literal nonnegative logarithmic integral with normalized trace and omitted zero atom. Construct finite integer matrices from approximate permutations, prove moment/norm control and zero-atom-compatible limit. Does not verify a claimed arbitrary-group counterexample.

entries.title: Colmezs Conjecture on Faltings Heights of CM Abelian Varieties
entries.scope: Credited Colmez–Obus individual theorem for all abelian CM fields and every type, with a proved explicit Fourier formula for coefficients, parity/Parseval/conductor checks and complete multiquadratic specialization. No general nonabelian or nonmaximal-order claim.
entries.author: /root/hundred_numbers

entries.title: Sums of Three Cubes Representation Conjecture
entries.scope: Complete classical congruence theorem: an integer is a sum of three cubes modulo every positive modulus iff it avoids4,5mod9; full finite-field, every-prime-power, special3-adic and CRT proofs. This proves local solubility only, not an exact integer representation or infinitude.
entries.author: /root/hundred_numbers

entries.title: Lusztig's P1-P15 Conjectures for Bounded Weighted Coxeter Groups
entries.scope: Credited full P1–P15 for affineG2 and affineC2 with arbitrary positive weights; complete direct-product transfer lemma including unspecialized P15. Hence arbitrary finite products of these affine factors satisfy the fixed2014 list, conditional only on their explicitly credited published factor theorems. General bounded weighted systems not claimed.

entries.title: Combinatorial Boolean multiplication from column interval runs
entries.scope: For Boolean n×n matrices and a given common row order for B, let κ be the total number of maximal one-runs in its columns. Full Boolean multiplication is deterministic in O(n²+nκ) logarithmic-word operations and O((n²+nκ)log(n+2)) bit time. In particular at most n^o(1) runs per column gives near-quadratic time on this subclass.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Potential Density of Rational Points on K3 Surfaces
entries.scope: Precisely recovers potential density for every number-field K3 surface of geometric Picard rank≥5 from the isotropic-divisor/fibration theorem and Bogomolov–Tschinkel, with finite-field-of-definition bookkeeping. Gives a concrete quartic-with-four-skew-lines criterion via a determinant96 certificate and explains the rank-four quadratic-form boundary.
entries.author: /root/hundred_numbers

entries.title: Koblitz Conjecture for Prime Orders of Elliptic Curves
entries.scope: Reconstructs the concrete Jones–Zywina entanglement obstruction for y²=x³+9x+18, proves its only prime-order good reduction occurs at p=5, and extends the divisibility obstruction to every number field. Explains exactly why this is outside the prompt's positive-corrected-constant hypothesis.

entries.title: The McKay-Navarro Conjecture for Finite Groups
entries.scope: For every finite G=A semidirect P with A abelian p-prime and P an arbitrary p-group, prove raw restriction is a bijection Irr_pprime(G)→Irr_pprime(N_G(P)), equivariant under the full cyclotomic Galois group. Removes prior restriction that P be abelian, with full degree and inertia argument.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Zagier's dimension conjecture for classical multiple zeta values
entries.scope: A proof-level reconstruction of Rivoal’s unconditional logarithmic numerical dimension bound for odd depth-one zeta values, including reflection cancellation, denominator/decay balancing and parameter optimization; explicit independent-class lower bounds after finite or growing odd-weight cutoffs and modulo arbitrary fixed finite-dimensional spaces. The fixed-weight numerical/motivic boundary and monomial diagnostic are retained; Zagier’s equality is not proved.
entries.author: /root/hundred_numbers

entries.title: Integral K5 injectivity for regular local domains
entries.scope: Credit Panin integral Gersten exactness for every equicharacteristic Noetherian regular local domain, hence K5 injectivity in all dimensions. Derive localization/support reformulation of the mixed-characteristic kernel and verify why the prior quartic local-ring geometry is outside that theorem without certifying its alleged K-class.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Integral Bloch statement for surfaces of geometric genus zero
entries.scope: Credited Bloch–Kas–Lieberman integral Albanese-kernel vanishing for all smooth projective complex surfaces with pg0 and Kodaira dimension<2, including Enriques/bielliptic/elliptic/ruled cases. Explain why uniform torsion plus divisibility yields integral rather than rational result and show the torsion-surjectivity proof of divisibility.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: The generalized Mukai pseudoindex assertion
entries.scope: Every smooth complex projective toric Fano variety in every positive dimension satisfies rho(iota−1)≤dim, with equality exactly (P^(iota−1))^rho. Credit Casagrande’s stronger Q-factorial Gorenstein theorem; prove the product pseudoindex/index calculation and distinguish pseudoindex from Fano index.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Rational Hodge classes on products of K3 surfaces
entries.scope: For every projective complex K3 surface S with End_Hdg(T(S))=Q or a CM field, prove algebraicity of all rational Hodge classes on S×S in every codimension, using Buskin’s algebraicity of rational Hodge isometries. Prove the norm-one spanning lemma and the Künneth reduction; no arbitrary-product or totally-real-extra-endomorphism conclusion.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Completeness of original Pixton relations on closed moduli
entries.scope: For every n≥3 over C, all relations among polynomials in boundary divisors on closed Mbar_0,n follow from the original Pixton relation ideal and its standard pull/push closure, modulo boundary incompatibility already built into strata multiplication. Prove the explicit 24(a−b) extraction from PPZ Mbar0,4 and invoke Keel’s full boundary-ring presentation. Do not claim full decorated-strata kernel completeness or positive-genus completeness.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Numerical semiampleness of projective adjoints
entries.scope: The literal numerical-semiampleness conclusion holds for every complex projective rational klt surface pair with K+B pseudo-effective and M nef rational Cartier, whenever K+B+M is nef, by Lazić–Peternell CorollaryC. Distinguish numerical semiampleness from semiampleness using an explicit non-torsion Pic0 example.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: P=W for fixed-determinant trace-free coprime moduli
entries.scope: For every rank/degree/genus in the literal prompt, prove P_k=W_2k=W_2k+1 on the entire Pic0(C)[r]-invariant rational cohomology, by checked published GL_r theorem and precise deCataldo–Maulik–Shen invariant reduction. Identify residual variant cohomology and explain averaging alone cannot settle it.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Tate classes on finite-field abelian varieties
entries.scope: For every elliptic E/Fq whose Frobenius trace a is prime to p=char(Fq), every power E^m satisfies Tate surjectivity in all codimensions over every finite extension, and numerical=ell-adic homological equivalence for rational cycles over Fqbar. Give explicit divisor generators using diagonal and Frobenius graphs and the full exterior-algebra proof; no general abelian variety claim.

entries.title: Simplex maximum for projection-body volume
entries.scope: Among all Cartesian products of simplices, the unique block dimension maximizing per-dimension normalized projection volume is13; exact finite comparisons plus an analytic tail prove the all-size optimal exponential rate c_13^(1/13), and products of13-simplices are exactly optimal at dimensions divisible by13 within this class.
entries.author: /root/hundred_geometry

entries.title: Single-lattice covering density of order n log n
entries.scope: For every n-dimensional polytope with at most n+2 vertices, the checked2025 theorem gives one-lattice covering density O(n(log n)^(1+log_2 e)); its explicit inscribed-cylinder iteration and absence of symmetry assumptions are verified, without adopting the prior unverified universal n log n theorem.
entries.author: /root/hundred_geometry

entries.title: Worst-case symmetric translative covering density
entries.scope: For every fixed full-dimensional compact convex body, translative covering density defined by centered-cube limsup equals its infimum over finite-pattern cubically periodic coverings; after arbitrarily small dilation the periodic centers and periods can be rational. This gives an exact witness reduction, not an n log n lower bound.
entries.author: /root/hundred_geometry

entries.title: A nontrivial group free-product Z cannot be normally generated by one element
entries.scope: For every group A possessing at least one nontrivial finite quotient and every w in A*Z, prove the one-relator quotient nontrivial; exponent sums0 and |e|>1 work for all A, while e=±1 is handled by the credited finite-group equation theorem. No residual-finiteness assumption needed.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Coefficient-preserving solutions of nonsingular group-equation systems
entries.scope: For any coefficient group whose finite-dimensional unitary representations separate points, every finite full-row-rank exponent-sum system has coefficient injectivity. Give compact Lie degree calculation, rectangular-to-square reduction and product separation; includes arbitrary-cardinality residually finite groups.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Recognizing virtually polycyclic groups from quasi-isometry
entries.scope: Credited Eskin–Fisher–Whyte quasi-isometric rigidity of Sol implies the recognition conclusion for every fg group quasi-isometric to a virtually cocompact Sol lattice, including all Z^2 semidirect Z hyperbolic integral monodromies. Explain polycyclicity and stability under finite kernels/index; no all-polycyclic recognition claim.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Coefficient injectivity for unimodular one-variable equations
entries.scope: Credited Klyachko theorem for every torsion-free coefficient group and every exponent±1 relator; transfer overgroup-solvability and Magnusian free-factor solution to injectivity/free-product subgroups in the universal one-relator quotient. General coefficient torsion case unclaimed.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algebra

entries.title: Finite-extension transfer and exceptional-prime specialization
entries.scope: For every fixed finite extension E/F, formal-bilinear matrix-multiplication exponents satisfy ωE=ωF. A fixed exact rational bilinear block identity also specializes unchanged outside its finite denominator-prime set. These proved transfer lemmas delimit valid characteristic arguments; they do not independently establish the prompt’s numerical exponent threshold.

entries.title: Deterministic weight removal and a certified Max-Cut hardness interval
entries.scope: Every fixed approximation ratio α>16/17 is NP-hard for Max-Cut on simple unweighted graphs, by the credited Håstad theorem and an explicit deterministic approximation-preserving conversion from nonnegative rational edge weights. The proof supplies the weight-removal construction; it does not certify the stronger 2026 manuscript claim or settle α in (αGW,16/17].
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Exact extremizers among symmetric polynomial thresholds
entries.scope: For permutation-invariant Boolean functions on the n-cube representable by degree-at-most-d real polynomial thresholds, the exact largest total influence is n/2^(n-1) times the sum of the d largest coefficients binomial(n-1,k), 0<=k<n. In particular I<=d sqrt(2n), with sign(0)=1. This is a self-contained symmetric subclass result, not an independent verification of the announced general bound.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: Horizon-free bounded-bit marking on uniform rational metrics
entries.scope: For every finite uniform rational metric of distance Δ>0 and 2≤k<n, a single randomized bit algorithm uses polynomial preprocessing and worst-case polynomial work per request in L+log(t+1), and has expected cost≤2Hk·OPT+2kΔ for every finite oblivious sequence from a common initial k-point configuration. This satisfies the prompt on uniform metrics, not arbitrary finite metrics.
entries.author: /root/hundred_algorithms

entries.title: A deterministic unweighted hardness range below the Dinur–Safra threshold
entries.scope: Credit and specialize the Dinur–Safra theorem: deterministic polynomial-time NP-hardness holds for every fixed approximation factor α<10√5−21 on simple unweighted Vertex Cover, hence for the literal prompt whenever ε>23−10√5. A complete rational weighted-to-unweighted rounding argument preserves the fixed gap with polynomial output length. The full factor-two threshold is not claimed.

entries.title: The strict two-category Thomason theorem and the precise transfer gap beyond it
entries.scope: The requested proper combinatorial model structure and Quillen equivalence are established for strict 2-categories with the geometric nerve specified by Ara; exact transfer hypotheses are identified. No all-finite-n or strict-∞ extension is inferred, and the earlier announced universal proof is not certified.

entries.title: Finite-group cancellation ranges for Wall's D₂ problem
entries.scope: For finite fundamental group G, χ(X)>1−def(G) gives a finite 2-complex simple-homotopy model; equality gives such a model after one S² stabilization. Every finite subgroup of SO(3) has the unstabilized D₂ property. No result for arbitrary groups or general cancellation of S² is claimed.
